headline: 2 injured in mosque shooting in Khulna
summary: Two worshippers were shot and injured during Fajr prayers in a Khulna mosque.
details: Two worshippers were shot and injured in a mosque in Khulna during the Fajr prayer.
The attackers entered the mosque and opened fire on the people praying.
The injured individuals have been taken for medical treatment.
Police are investigating the incident to identify and capture the attackers.

headline: High Court accepts jail appeal of two in Ramisa murder case
summary: The court will hear the appeal of Sohel Rana and Swapna Khatun, who were previously sentenced to death for the rape and murder of an 8-year-old girl.
details: The High Court has accepted the jail appeal of Sohel Rana and Swapna Khatun, who were sentenced to death for the rape and murder of 8-year-old Ramisa Akter in the capital's Pallabi area.
caption:
Death row convicts in the rape and murder of an 8-year-old girl have filed an appeal against their sentence.

The High Court has accepted the jail appeal of Sohel Rana and Swapna Khatun, who were sentenced to death for the rape and murder of 8-year-old Ramisa Akter in the capital's Pallabi area.

#Bangladesh #Justice #HighCourt #CrimeNews #Dhaka

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News
